name: typography
title: Typography
description: Typography scale definitions, utilities, and composition patterns for the Aura design system. Includes structured data for LLM consumption with HTML/JSX examples.

files.content:
/** * Aura Typography System * * This file contains the canonical typography scale for the Aura design system. * It exports structured data for LLM consumption, utility functions, and * common composition patterns. * * Font families: * - Inter: Primary text (body, UI elements) * - Space Grotesk: Marketing/display text * - Source Code Pro: Code blocks */ // Typography scale - the single source of truth for Aura typography export const typographyScale = [ { section: 'Text', name: 'xxs/normal', fontFamily: 'Inter', fontWeight: 'Regular', fontSize: '10px', lineHeight: '12px', usage: 'metadata; short labels', tailwindClass: 'text-2xs font-normal', }, { section: 'Text', name: 'xxs/medium', fontFamily: 'Inter', fontWeight: 'Medium', fontSize: '10px', lineHeight: '12px', usage: 'metadata; short labels; emphasis', tailwindClass: 'text-2xs font-medium', }, { section: 'Text', name: 'xs/normal', fontFamily: 'Inter', fontWeight: 'Regular', fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: '14px', usage: 'charting labels', tailwindClass: 'text-xs font-normal', }, { section: 'Text', name: 'xs/medium', fontFamily: 'Inter', fontWeight: 'Medium', fontSize: '12px', lineHeight: '14px', usage: 'charting labels; labels', tailwindClass: 'text-lg font-normal', }, { section: 'Text', name: 'lg/medium', fontFamily: 'Inter', fontWeight: 'Medium', fontSize: '18px', lineHeight: '24px', usage: 'headers; subtitles; labels; onboarding, sign-in; emphasis', tailwindClass: 'font-marketing text-2xl font-medium', }, { section: 'Text', name: '3xl/normal', fontFamily: 'Inter', fontWeight: 'Regular', fontSize: '28px', lineHeight: '32px', usage: 'headers; export type TypographySection = 'Text' | 'Marketing' | 'Code'; export type TypographyItem = (typeof typographyScale)[number]; /** * Get all typography items for a specific section */ export function getTypographyBySection(section: TypographySection): TypographyItem[] { return typographyScale.filter((t) => t.section === section); } /** * Find a typography item by name and optional section */ export function findTypography(name: string, section?: TypographySection): TypographyItem | undefined { return typographyScale.find((t) => t.name === name && (!section || t.section === section)); } /** * For LLM consumption - typography examples with HTML/JSX code */ export const typographyExamples = typographyScale.map((t) => ({ ...t, htmlExample: `

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

`, jsxExample: `

The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

`, })); /** * Typography composition patterns * * These patterns show how to combine typography variants for common UI scenarios. * Use these as recipes when building interfaces. */ export const typographyPatterns = { pageHeader: { name: 'Page Header', description: 'Standard page header with title and subtitle', elements: [ { role: 'title', class: 'text-4xl font-medium', description: 'Main page title' }, { role: 'subtitle', class: 'text-lg font-normal text-muted-foreground', description: 'Supporting description', }, ], htmlExample: `

`, jsxExample: `

`, jsxExample: `

`, }, formField: { name: 'Form Field', description: 'Form field with label, input, and helper text', elements: [ { role: 'label', class: 'text-sm font-medium', description: 'Field label' }, { role: 'input', class: 'text-base font-normal', description: 'Input text' }, { role: 'helper', class: 'text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground', description: 'Helper or error text', }, ], htmlExample: `

We'll never share your email with anyone else.

`, jsxExample: `

`, }, articleBody: { name: 'Article Body', description: 'Long-form content with headings and paragraphs', elements: [ { role: 'h1', class: 'text-3xl font-medium', description: 'Article title' }, { role: 'h2', class: 'text-2xl font-medium', description: 'Section heading' }, { role: 'h3', class: 'text-xl font-medium', description: 'Subsection heading' }, { role: 'body', class: 'text-base font-normal', description: 'Body paragraphs' }, { role: 'caption', class: 'text-sm font-normal text-muted-foreground', description: 'Image captions, footnotes', }, ], htmlExample: `

`, jsxExample: `

`, }, marketingHero: { name: 'Marketing Hero', description: 'Hero section for marketing pages', elements: [ { role: 'headline', class: 'font-marketing text-5xl font-bold', description: 'Main headline' }, { role: 'subheadline', class: 'text-xl font-normal text-muted-foreground', description: 'Supporting tagline', }, ], htmlExample: `
